descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-16 ER with 3.3; TFA-92594 AC 3 · “Collapsed rows show accurate labeling and line count”.

Approach · TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · S04 Nursing Home: an archived visit is listed collapsed with its line count and expands to its text

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 The physician can open Prior Encounter Transcripts for a patient, and the prior encounters are listed there automatically. (UAT TC-16; TFA-92594 How it works 2; TFA-92594 AC 2)
  • U3 Entries display collapsed, each with a line count, and the line count is accurate. (UAT TC-16; TFA-92594 AC 3; TFA-92594 How it works 3)
  • U4 Expanding a collapsed entry shows the correct full transcript: that visit's lines for that patient, all of them, and nothing from another entry. (UAT TC-16; TFA-92594 AC 4; TFA-92594 How it works 4)
  • U8 Works in both Hospital and Nursing Home, and passes in both. (UAT 3.3; TFA-92594 AC 2)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Tim's chromium test: SNF resident with one archived row 'Sep 23 · Visit notes' (1 line) set through snf:update

When Open the resident's Encounter tab and expand the row

Then 'Prior Encounter Transcripts' visible; row shows '1 lines' with the text hidden; after the tap the visit text is visible and aria-expanded is true

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions: visitRow toContainText '1 lines', text toBeHidden, then toBeVisible after the click (U3, U4, U8). The row is seeded directly, so this proves neither the Nursing Home rotation nor the two-visit rule (S11)

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S04 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-16.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · Section: A3 · Encounter · Scenario: TC-16/S04

Nursing Home: an archived visit is listed collapsed with its line count and expands to its text

Tickets: TFA-92594 Prior Encounter Transcripts (ready for qa)

Result: passed in matrix/TC-16.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).
